patterns.note: Full-bleed black background serves as a canvas for high-contrast white text and striking red display typography, creating a dramatic and minimalist aesthetic.
Extreme contrast in typography is used, featuring oversized, decorative serif fonts for primary titles and section anchors, paired with small, clean sans-serifs for body text and navigation.
A highly restricted color palette of black, white, and a single vibrant red (#c91818) is used to create a bold, high-contrast visual identity.
Massive display titles (e.g., 'RANBOO', 'SHOP ALL') are fixed or scroll at a slower rate, allowing other content to scroll over them, creating a layered, parallax-like reveal effect.
The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid black background as it becomes sticky at the top of the viewport.
Content sections, such as text blocks and product grids, are revealed with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as they enter the viewport.
A continuous horizontal scrolling text marquee is used as a dynamic visual divider or accent between content sections.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a smooth scrolling library, likely locomotive-scroll, to enable custom scroll-triggered animations and a fluid user experience.

Large, full-width display text elements are positioned with a fixed or sticky behavior, allowing other content to scroll over them, creating a dramatic reveal and hide effect that acts as a visual anchor.
The main navigation bar dynamically changes its appearance on scroll, transitioning from a transparent, taller state to a compact, solid black sticky header.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, decorative serif headings (~8-10x body text) create dramatic visual anchors, contrasted with small, clean sans-serif body and navigation text.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners, with subtle rounding on product cards and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and open, particularly in the hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of luxury and focus on individual elements.

standout: The site's distinctive use of massive, fixed-position typography that acts as a dynamic background and section divider is highly impactful. This creates a unique, layered scrolling experience where content appears to emerge from behind or over these bold textual statements, giving the site a strong, almost brutalist editorial feel.
